objective: 补齐真实Strategy Agent路径的identity-exact ledger、pending、frontier与contradiction falsifier

semantic_brief.summary: 以generic Scripted Fake World从Strategy admission一路运行到Agent ledger projection，不用纯算术替代真实路径，证明2/1/0/1、classified pending、record-only frontier和矛盾证据fail closed。
core_points: 一个container经authorization traversal verified return进入Visited
真实boundary evidence为Visited加unknown frontier且contradiction throw

change_principles: 只新增一个scenario-neutral Strategy测试文件，不改production、existing tests、fixtures、schema或文档

使用真实StrategyContractCompiler accepted intent、StrategyExecution.RunAsync、Agent OpenWorld、ScriptedEnvironment、generic CategoryClassifier/Inventory/Authorization与真实verified parent return；不得直接向Agent私有字段写证据
exact fixture的root accepted inventory必须恰含两个可区分identity：一个classified NavigableContainer并authorized/dispatch/verified return；一个classifier null且零authorization/dispatch；最终同一root ledger精确2/1/0/1
按唯一bounds分别证明container Tap存在、unclassifiable Tap不存在；同时检查AuthorizedSiblingEvidence、CompletedSiblingEvidence与Unresolved count真实来源
pending fixture的classified container无RecordOnly/completion/unresolved satisfaction且authorization denied或既有真实门拒绝；Run结束后ledger必须1/0/1/0，零Tap，证明authorization/dispatch不决定primary disposition
depth0真实Strategy boundary通过Agent产生RecordOnlySatisfied和UnknownFrontier identity，ledger必须1/1/0/0且UnknownFrontier 1，不增加Discovered
contradiction falsifier先运行真实boundary Agent取得actual inventory/RecordOnly evidence，再只在internal compiler input中叠加同identity unresolved并断言throw；不得伪造一个脱离真实Run的count-only case
acceptance: real exact test断言root ledger Discovered=2 Visited=1 Pending=0 Unresolved=1 UnknownFrontier=0；completed identity恰为container，unresolved count恰1且unclassifiable未授权未Tap
real pending test断言ledger 1/0/1/0、classified identity不在Completed/RecordOnly/Unresolved且其bounds零Tap
real depth0 boundary test断言record-only identity与unknown-frontier identity都来自Agent，ledger 1/1/0/0/frontier1且boundary bounds零Tap
actual Agent boundary evidence叠加同identity unresolved时ExplorationLedgerCompiler.CompileScope抛InvalidOperationException，不clamp
测试不得使用固定总点击数、UI场景知识、业务label、route、selector或production hook；只按generic identity与唯一bounds判断
新增测试加原97个定向回归全部通过，Runtime build 0 error且git diff仅新增scope.write
forbidden: 禁止修改production、公开API、Strategy wire/schema、GoalEvidence、Agent/FSM/Traversal或现有test support
禁止直接设置Agent私有evidence字段、用reflection mutation、mock Compile结果或count arithmetic替代真实Agent path
禁止固定总Tap/click数作为规则证据；只能对目标唯一bounds做正负断言
禁止引入scenario-specific labels、Settings知识、坐标常量到production或新semantic capability
escalation: 若真实two-node inventory无法通过现有generic evidence seams构造，返回具体阻塞与trace，不得修改production绕过
若classified unsatisfied真实Run无法终止于existing bounded behavior，保留trace并返回Leader
若任何测试需要新owner/schema/state/scene knowledge，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
